question_texts.refresh_43507_20260731: Will Bitcoin trade above $120,000 before August 1, 2026?

research_texts.refresh_43507_20260731:
Forecasts for Bitcoin reaching $120,000 by August 1, 2026, are generally low. Metaculus assigns a 0.5% chance to this outcome by August 2026, though a previous comment noted Bitcoin already surpassed $120,000 multiple times in 2025, most recently on October 10 [metaculus.com](https://www.metaculus.com/questions/43502/will-btc-hit-120k-by-aug-2026/). Another platform, Orrery, gives a 7% implied probability for Bitcoin reaching $120,000 by December 31, 2026 [orrery.me](https://orrery.me/markets/will-bitcoin-reach-120000-by-december-31-2026-625-425-562).

The $120,000 thesis is currently challenged by persistent U.S. wage growth (3.8% year-on-year in March), which could limit the Federal Reserve's rate cuts, thereby hindering risk assets like Bitcoin [twohootsandaholler.com](https://twohootsandaholler.com/article/bitcoin-s-120k-path-wage-growth-and-the-u-s-jobs-report). Macroeconomic risks like stagflation, with Brent crude oil above $100 a barrel, also present a bearish outlook [okawashashin.com](https://okawashashin.com/article/bitcoin-s-120k-path-wage-growth-and-the-u-s-jobs-report). Technically, Bitcoin has retreated from its 200-day moving average, with a breakdown below $75,000 indicating a broader trend shift [twohootsandaholler.com](https://twohootsandaholler.com/article/bitcoin-s-120k-path-wage-growth-and-the-u-s-jobs-report). Institutional demand, as indicated by the Coinbase Premium Index, has also shifted to a discount when Bitcoin rallied above $80,000 [news.nbtc.finance](https://news.nbtc.finance/bitcoin-options-traders-load-up-on-120k-strike-through-december-2026/).
